summary: The tractor list finally has a priced, in-band strong find: a 2022 McCormick 90hp loader tractor at $62,000. The Leeton offset discs, the only strong set, have sold. Kioti was searched for the first time and nothing used at 90hp or more is in range.
headlines: New: 2022 McCormick 90hp, cab, loader, 4-in-1, 251 hrs, $62,000, Yarroweyah VIC, 190 km. Listed 10 weeks, so confirm first.
Sold: Leeton 24-plate offset discs ($12,000, 50 km), the only strong set. Griffith Blue Line 28-plate at $7,500 is now closest.
New: 2014 JD 6150 with loader, 3,900 hrs, Barellan clearing sale 5 Nov, 110 km. No guide price yet.
New: Stihl MS 660 Magnum with two 30in bars, $1,500 in Melbourne.
Kioti searched for the first time: nothing used at 90hp+ in range; a 2022 RX8030 (under 90hp) is $63,250 at Swan Hill.
Grays Shepparton 2-bed closes tonight 9:40pm with 0 bids at $22,000; it no longer makes the top six.
